# jsQR 1.4.0

QR code reader by Cosmo Wolfe, used by the notes app to scan the computer's
pairing code with the iPad camera (iPad Safari has no built-in QR detector).
Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).

Copied unmodified from the npm package `jsqr@1.4.0` (`dist/jsQR.js`, renamed
to lowercase `jsqr.js` so the server's file allowlist serves it). Package
integrity, as published on registry.npmjs.org:
